extracted text: The materials used in this study were in the form of cold rolled plate of Al 2024-T351 of 2mm total thickness, with a pure aluminium cladding of 100μm on both faces. For the Al cladding, reverse analysis was used for extraction of elastic-plastic properties and a yield stress of 110-120 MPa and a value of 0.075-0.1 for the work hardening exponent was obtained.
property mapping: Yield stress (MPa) → YS [MPa], UTS (MPa) → UTS [MPa], Strain-to-failure (%) → elong [%]
abbreviations: T351 refers to a temper designation where T3 means solution heat treated, cold worked, and naturally aged, with the 51 indicating stress-relieved stretching.
weight percentage: No explicit weight percentages for alloying elements are provided in the document.
